title: $26.6M in backup battery subsidies approved by City Council, will use Entergy settlement cash
creator: BY JONAH MEADOWS | Staff writer
description: The New Orleans City Council has cleared the way for a new backup battery program that advocates say will help keep the lights on at homes, businesses and community sites when the grid goes down.

title: Nuclear reactors, data center campuses, gas-powered plants proposed in Iberville, Ascension
creator: BY JONAH MEADOWS | Staff writer
description: A Florida-based energy startup is pitching Ascension and Iberville parishes on an ambitious series of large-scale projects that the company says could lead to as much as $40 billion in capital investment and boost Louisiana’s electricity generation capacity by 20%.

title: Virtual power plant advances, makes backup batteries effectively free for lower-income homes
creator: BY JONAH MEADOWS | Staff writer
description: A backup battery program that advocates say will keep the lights on at more than 1,000 New Orleans homes and businesses when the grid goes down has cleared a key hurdle at the City Council, moving the initiative one step…

title: Entergy New Orleans launches $4M project upgrading 94 electrical poles in Leonidas, Holly Grove
creator: BY JONAH MEADOWS | Staff writer
description: Entergy New Orleans broke ground Tuesday on a $4 million project to strengthen the electrical grid by upgrading 94 poles over about 1.6 miles of its distribution network in the Leonidas and Holly Grove neighborhoods.

title: Sports Drink owner will open new NOLA comedy club with national headliners, pizza and a pool
creator: BY JONAH MEADOWS | Staff writer
description: The owner of Sports Drink, the Irish Channel venue that's a coffee shop by day and a 50-seat comedy club at night, is planning a second nearby club that will give the New Orleans stand-up comedy scene its largest-ever dedicated…

title: Rebranded Tipitina's Foundation gets into the groove, 8 years after Galactic bought Uptown club
creator: BY JONAH MEADOWS | Staff writer
description: As Tipitina’s prepares to embark on a year of events to commemorate the iconic music venue’s 50th anniversary, its owners are rebranding the club’s charitable foundation to better reflect its mission of promoting New Orleans music, culture and heritage.

title: Spectrum takes over cable, internet service across south Louisiana after $34.5 billion deal
creator: BY JONAH MEADOWS | Staff writer
description: Cox Communications, the brand that has provided cable and, more recently, internet services in Louisiana since cable television was in its infancy 45 years ago, was officially rebranded as Spectrum on Wednesday across the state.

title: Mo Vij sold his Baton Rouge tech company. Then he built a bigger one at same campus.
creator: BY JONAH MEADOWS | Staff writer
description: When entrepreneur Mo Vij sold General Informatics in 2020 after building it into one of Baton Rouge’s biggest technology companies, he had a decision to make. Should he stay in town or start his next venture elsewhere?

title: Beyoncé, Taylor Swift and Elton John have worn his designs. Now he's opened on Magazine Street.
creator: BY JONAH MEADOWS | Staff writer
description: Beyoncé has rocked his rhinestone jacket. Elton John has donned his sequins. Taylor Swift has featured a sparkling cape he designed in a music video.

title: By the numbers: 'Generous bonus' boosts St. Tammany Parish wage growth to nation's highest
creator: BY JONAH MEADOWS | Staff writer
description: Two Louisiana parishes have posted some of the sharpest wage spikes anywhere in the country so far this year, new federal employment data shows.
